speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me your name and how old you are? Also, can you describe the skin lesions you are presenting with?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
Given the exposure to a child with similar lesions and the description of painless, nonpruritic papules, I suspect Molluscum Contagiosum.
